x-http.notes: Feature 027: client_name is now resolved via _resolve_client_by_name before the payload is built. On exactly one match, the payload's client object is {"self": false, "id": "<resolved client_id>"} - no name field (confirmed live against the real sandbox, research.md Decision 1). On zero matches, no /documents call is made at all - returns a friendly 'client not found' message (format_client_not_found). On >1 matches, no call is made - returns the existing disambiguation message (format_ambiguous_clients_message). On a single NON-exact (fuzzy/substring) match, the document is still created, but the confirmation reply discloses the real matched client name (REQ-INV-011).

client_name.description: Free-text client reference - resolved to a real client record, never passed through as a bare string (REQ-INV-001/002).
